Bihar government's school painting plan sparks political debate

The Bihar government's decision to paint new model schools in a shade identified as "Sunrise" has ignited a political controversy. While the government describes the color as "Sunrise" with gold brown doors, critics and an NDA ally have protested, interpreting the shade as saffron and raising concerns about its religious connotations in educational institutions. The row highlights differing perspectives on the government's choices for public infrastructure.
